name: import-linter-portable-lint-report-archives
instr:
Import Linter cannot save completed results for later replay without importing the analyzed package or rebuilding its graph. Add portable, versioned JSON archives whose Python and command-line replay reproduces the original untimed report and established statuses.

Serialization must be deterministic and lossless for JSON-compatible metadata, regardless of collection ordering or native tuples, sets, mappings, and dataclasses. ForbiddenContract, LayersContract, IndependenceContract, ProtectedContract, and AcyclicSiblingsContract must preserve their complete renderable meaning through archive_check(self, check, duration_ms=None) and restore_check(self, archived). Every Contract must convert its completed ContractCheck to an archive record and restore a renderable check of the same contract type. Preserve contract order, graph totals, durations, warnings, ignored imports, failure state, and every contract-specific detail.

write_lint_archive(archive, destination) must replace artifacts atomically. to_json(self) and loading must reject unsupported objects, malformed content, unsupported versions, contract mismatches, and configuration mismatches before exposing partial state. Compare configurations deterministically using ordered contract identities and normalized session options. Treat root_package and equivalent root_packages forms alike without evaluating contracts.

Keep ordinary lint_imports behavior, output ordering, warnings, timing suppression, and debug exception propaga
